place.name: Curanipe
place.description: Curanipe (in mapudungun: "plum tree that grows in the rock") is a town and seat of the municipality of Pelluhue, Province of Cauquenes, in VII Maule Region of Chile. As a popular coastal resort, Curanipe used to be known as an exclusive hangout for the Cauquenes elite and a regional "minor port", during the mid- and late 19th century.
